abstract: GitHub search results showing commits co-authored by Claude across public repositories. The data demonstrates Claude Code's rapid adoption in software development, with 135K+ daily commits representing approximately 4% of all public GitHub commits as of early 2026, reflecting a 42,896x growth in the 13 months since launch.
keyFindings: Claude Code reached 135,000+ daily commits on public GitHub repositories, accounting for approximately 4% of all public commits.
Growth rate of 42,896x in commits over 13 months from Claude Code's launch.
At current trajectory, Claude Code is projected to reach 20%+ of daily commits by the end of 2026.
Search results show 6 million total commits co-authored by Claude across diverse repositories and organizations.
methodology: GitHub Search API query filtering commits by 'co-authored-by: claude' across public repositories. Data source is live GitHub commit metadata as of February 2, 2026. Specific sample size and analytical approach not detailed in source; represents searchable public commit data only.
qualifiers: Limited to public GitHub repositories only; does not include private repositories. Search results show co-authored commits, which may involve multiple contributors. Projection to 20%+ by end of 2026 assumes continuation of current trajectory without accounting for potential market saturation, competitive factors, or adoption changes. Specific date range for commit counting not explicitly stated.
